rules: Treat mapped GitHub repo/branch as canonical source of truth
Use test-first changes for behavior and bug fixes
Keep production and preview/runtime boundaries fail-closed
Update this continuation state after every meaningful work cycle

lastMeaningfulCycle.objective: Convert a minimized authenticated Fourthwall paid-order envelope into one idempotent private Issue reservation outcome.
changes: Added PaidOrderWebhookService with dependency-injected clock and Issue-code generator
Authenticated events are recorded before processing
Fourthwall testMode events are isolated as IGNORED_TEST and never create production Issues
Missing/unknown quote correlation and quote reconciliation mismatches are terminal/no-Issue outcomes
Normal reservation passes only event/order/quote identity to the repository; provider/customer/product/price fields are not accepted
Duplicate reservation returns the existing permanent Issue code
Issue-code collisions retry with fresh random candidates up to five attempts
Collision-budget exhaustion and repository failures are classified retryable
